title: explainer-engine: a video written as code

beats.text: This video was written as code.
It's made with explainer engine. You write a script, then you design the film in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
A local voice reads the script, and every word gets a timestamp. So every move lands on the word you hear.
Chromium renders every frame, with real motion blur. One continuous take. No slides.
Change the whole look with one flag. Collage, or terminal.
It's free and open source, even for commercial use. Find it on GitHub, at wild sec slash explainer engine.
